title: UserTrade
description: A trade execution record from the user's perspective.

taker_side.description: The side of the taker (the order that matched). ASK = taker sold, BID = taker bought.

side.description: The side from the maker's perspective. SELF_TRADING indicates both sides of the trade were from the same user.

maker_order_id.description: The order ID of the maker (the liquidity provider). Null if the maker order was not found.

taker_order_id.description: The order ID of the taker (the liquidity taker).

maker_fee.description: The fee paid by the maker (negative values indicate rebates). Null if the user was the taker.

taker_fee.description: The fee paid by the taker. Null if the user was the maker.

inserted_at.description: The timestamp when the trade was recorded (RFC3339 with millisecond precision).
